title: Notch Improvement | Clo 2025.1 Features Deep Dive
description:

summary: # Notch Improvement | CLO 2025.1 Features Deep Dive ## Introduction Hey everyone, it's Phoebe here, and I have some great updates to share with you regarding our Notches and Seam Allowance. So let's dive in and have some fun while we learn! ## Seam Allowance Updates First things first, when you add in Seam Allowance, like I have done here, you can simply click on the line, and Seam Allowance will be added. That's always been the case—it's very easy to add Seam Allowance. Bam! Look at that! What has been nice is that now when you use this dropdown, you can see all your options really quickly. When you hover over, you'll see what each one is, which is a nice improvement. It's basically just a fun UI addition. You can even select a corner here; in this dropdown, it will just extend. You don't have to scroll or anything—you can just hover over and see all these different options. You can click whatever you'd like. A nice UI change that I think is worth mentioning. ## Notch Updates Another significant UI change worth mentioning is the Notch Updates, particularly how you can view your Notches. If I go up top to my Settings in the toolbar and then go to User Settings, followed by 2D, I'll have a whole option of Notch settings. You can choose actual length or fixed length to screen. If you select length fixed to screen, what will happen is that if I zoom out, it will get bigger, and if I zoom in, it will get smaller. The notch will adjust based on your screen view. In the new option under Settings, User Settings, and then 2D, you also have the actual length setting. This allows you to set what you want your actual length to be. Additionally, you can set your notch default type. You could specify that you want it to be V, T, or maybe even I. Personally, I want to go with I. Once you set that, you can hit close, and it will be fixed at 3.5. These are some nice, easy UI updates! ## Enhanced Control for Notches We've also enhanced control in the corners of the notches, thanks to our fantastic users who have explained why this is necessary. A big thank you to all the users who have contributed— you know who you are! One of the great features is that I can select my notch and then see options for angle, perpendicular, or custom. You have your length, so I’m going to set it to 0.354. For direction, I can choose point center, segment one, segment two, and then again point center. Notch placement options include center, seam line extend, point perpendicular, and seam allowance perpendicular. Additionally, you can flip the notch if needed. These options are extremely helpful, especially when you're entering production or working on complex designs. When you select just segment one, you will have seam line extend. For segment two, you’ll also have seam line extend or center. If I select point again, I’ll have even more options available. You can change your notch type if you want to. I'm going to stick with I, but you can also create a custom notch if desired. I’ll keep mine set to perpendicular. ## Conclusion Lots of really great updates with this notch feature! If you have any questions, please use the comment section down below. Don't forget to like and subscribe. Keep having fun in CLO, and thanks again for watching!
